intent.proves: At least one active discount has an active reward.
intent.scope: active discounts of the new engine

bindings.reason: Needs includeDetails and a reward projection; handler not implemented.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomDiscounts d WHERE d.DiscountActive = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomDiscountReward r WHERE r.DiscountRewardDiscountId = d.DiscountId AND r.DiscountRewardActive = 1)

sources.ref: DW10 database schema (INFORMATION_SCHEMA of a local DW10 install) and Dynamicweb.Ecommerce 10.29.8
